Priya Patel: Heads-up — GH Actions eval-matrix is flaking on quantized jobs on self-hosted runners since the last deploy. Example failure: `segfault while loading libquant.so`. Seen ~1/3 runs. cc @Alex Chen
Alex Chen: Yeah, saw that in the logs this morning. Suspect concurrent artifact writes / cache key collision between matrix jobs. Can you paste the failing step output?
Priya Patel: Paste of the failing snippet:
```
error: dlopen failed: cannot allocate memory: '/opt/runner/_work/_temp/libquant.so'
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
Tomás Rivera: This looks like the old /tmp race where multiple matrix jobs write the same cache dir on self-hosted images. Quick workaround: give quant jobs unique cache keys or temporarily set `strategy.max-parallel: 1` for the quant matrix.
Alex Chen: Also try making cache path matrix-aware, e.g.:
```yaml
- name: Cache quant artifacts
  uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.cache/quant-${{ matrix.q }}
    key: quant-${{ matrix.q }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/quant-lock.txt') }}
```
Priya Patel: I'll iterate that in a branch now. Noted that sometimes the job also times out pulling docker layers on the runner which makes retries worse.
infra-bot: Runner heartbeat: self-hosted-runner-12 lost heartbeat at 2069993502, reconnect queued
Emma Li: If runner flakiness continues, fallback the PR-gate quant path to hosted for now. You can gate with `if: matrix.q == 'quant' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'` to force hosted runners for PRs.
Tomás Rivera: For nightly schedules let's also stagger the quant jobs to avoid the spike — small jitter or a split cron window (e.g. run portions at 03:00, 03:20, 03:40).
Alex Chen: I pushed a draft PR with the cache key change + `strategy.max-parallel: 2` for quant: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1422
Priya Patel: Running the new workflow on my branch now. Will backfill nightlies if stable.
Emma Li: Add a tiny PR smoke job that does a single quant model load+one-forward pass to catch segfaults quickly. Keeps full evals gated behind green.
Priya Patel: Good call — adding that smoke test now. Thanks :thumbsup:
Buildkite Bot: [buildkite] Job 'eval-nightly-quant' queued on pool 'gcp-rt-quant' (id: bk-9987)
Alex Chen: Marking resolved for now. Reopen if flakes reappear.
